diagram_math_checks.check: Four vertices are the four C^Q tensor factors of H_(Q,4), not objects of a commutative diagram. All seven e_i have domain and codomain H_(Q,4). Odd e_(2j-1) acts by sqrt(Q)|+><+| on factor j and identity elsewhere; even e_(2j) acts by sqrt(Q) sum_a |aa><aa| on factors j,j+1 and identity elsewhere.
diagram_math_checks.justification: def-potts-open-chain-clock-shift-representation Definition specifies H_(Q,L) and the tensor-factor subscripts; item Statement and proof 1.1 identify the projectors.

diagram_math_checks.check: At vertices j=1,2,3,4 the drawn labels are e1,e3,e5,e7. On edges (1,2),(2,3),(3,4) the labels are e2,e4,e6. There are four distinct vertices, three edges, degrees 1,2,2,1, and no last-to-first edge. Edges assert adjacency/support only, not maps, orientation, commutativity, or equality of generators.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Item proof 2.1 assigns odd index 2j-1 to 1<=j<=L and even index 2j to 1<=j<L. Supplier Definition explicitly excludes a generator joining last to first.

diagram_math_checks.check: L=4 gives 4+3=7=2L-1. The caption states the general L+(L-1) count and L=1 gives just e1. The picture imposes no Q-dependent topology: it applies separately to Q=2,3,4 with the unchanged parameter pairs (sqrt(2),exp(i*pi/4)), (sqrt(3),exp(i*pi/6)), (2,1). Their q+q^-1 values are respectively sqrt(2),sqrt(3),2.
